sum_insured_options: ₹3L (illustrated; exact range not specified in wording)

room_rent.note: If a higher room category is chosen, associate medical expenses are pro-rated in proportion to the difference in room rent.

icu.note: ICU charges are defined but no specific cap or limit is stated in the policy wording.

copayment.note: Applies to each and every claim for individual insured persons with entry age ≥60, and for all insured persons under a floater if the eldest member's entry age is ≥60. This is an optional Special Condition (Special Condition 2) applicable only if mentioned in the Policy Schedule.

sub_limits.note: The policy references sub-limits conceptually (Clause 6.1.5(I)) but no specific disease/procedure sub-limits are listed in the base wording. Maternity benefit has a separate limit as specified in the Policy Schedule.

deductible.note: No deductible mentioned in the base policy.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents are exempt.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months of continuous coverage required before PED claims are admissible.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, ENT disorders, BPH, varicose veins, etc.) excluded for 24 months from policy inception.

maternity.display: Covered (9 mo wait – Joy Today; 24 mo wait – Joy Tomorrow)
maternity.note: Inbuilt Benefit 4; limit as per Policy Schedule. Waiting period: 9 months continuous coverage under Joy Today plan or 24 months under Joy Tomorrow plan. Voluntary termination before 12 weeks of conception not covered. Ectopic pregnancy covered under Benefit 1. Insured must be ≤45 years.

cumulative_bonus.note: No Claim Bonanza is an optional cover (Optional Cover 1). Provides 100% of SI as bonus after 3 consecutive claim-free policy years. No inbuilt cumulative bonus exists in the base plan.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation medical expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation medical expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive list of day-care procedures in Annexure I is covered.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered when patient cannot be moved to hospital or no room is available.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatments (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) covered under Benefit 7 up to Sum Insured, subject to in-patient admission criteria.

organ_donor.note: Expenses related to donor treatment including surgery to remove organs from donor are permanently excluded (Clause 4.2(b)(xi)).

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered under Benefit 3 up to the amount specified in the Policy Schedule for emergency transport to nearest hospital.

modern_treatments.note: Advance Technology Methods including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, deep brain stimulation, HIFU, balloon sinuplasty, bronchial thermoplasty, green/holmium laser prostate treatment, IONM, and hematopoietic stem cell therapy are covered under Benefit 1.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items are excluded per Annexure II (List of Non-Medical Items). No optional rider for consumables mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only; treatment outside India is a permanent exclusion (Clause 4.2(b)(xiv)).

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years (60 months), no look-back applies. Claims cannot be contested except for proven permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium payment mode; 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Organ donor surgery, OPD treatment, overseas treatment, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, external congenital anomaly, ectopic pregnancy (maternity benefit only), voluntary termination <12 weeks

optional_riders.display: No Claim Bonanza (100% SI after 3 claim-free years); Co-payment waiver (Special Condition); Floater cover
